services.desc: The scene is spectacular. Fishing that is fun for every age. No combat fishing here. The most commonly caught fish are grayling and rainbow trout. We keep a constant eye on lakes where our guests have been most successful in catching fish. These lakes are full of grayling. It’s fun for every age - kids too. You'll rarely see other people at the lake where you are flown to - no combat fishing here. Not to mention spectacular scenery. Experience remote lake and river fishing with the convenience and comfort of professional guide by your side.
